name: TC-E2E-001 — 完整正向流程：创建迭代→Brief→试拍→审核→归档 [P0]
description: 端到端正向主流程：店铺列表新增视觉→买手下Brief→产运确认→试拍上传→买手审核通过→Leader确认通过→归档

steps.text: ═══ Phase 1: 店铺列表-新增视觉迭代 → DRAFT_BRIEF ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tbody tr'); for (const row of rows) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('新增视觉') && !b.disabled); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false, msg: '无可用店铺' }; })()
steps.description: P1: 点击新增视觉迭代

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, [class*=modal]'); if (!modal) return { modalVisible: false }; const nameInput = modal.querySelector('input'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('确') || b.textContent.includes('创建')); return { modalVisible: true, hasNameInput: !!nameInput, hasConfirmBtn: !!confirmBtn }; })()
steps.description: P1断言: 新增迭代弹窗展示(迭代名称输入+确认按钮)

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, [class*=modal]'); const input = modal?.querySelector('input'); if (input) { const nativeInputValueSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; nativeInputValueSetter.call(input, 'E2E正向流程验证迭代'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal?.querySelectorAll('button') || []).find(b => b.textContent.includes('确') || b.textContent.includes('创建')); if (confirmBtn) confirmBtn.click(); return { filled: !!input, confirmed: !!confirmBtn }; })()
steps.description: P1操作: 填写迭代名称并确认创建

steps.expression: (() => { const activeTab = document.querySelector('.ant-tabs-tab-active')?.textContent.trim(); const formVisible = !!document.querySelector('input, textarea'); const saveDraft = !!Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('保存草稿')); const submit = !!Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('提交')); const steps = ['买手下 Brief', '产运确认', '试拍', '试拍审核', 'Leader 复核', '视觉归档']; const text = document.body.textContent; const stepsFound = steps.filter(s => text.includes(s)); const activeStep = document.querySelector('.ant-steps-item-process')?.textContent.trim(); return { activeTab, formVisible, saveDraft, submit, stepsFound: stepsFound.length, totalSteps: 6, activeStep }; })()
steps.description: P2断言: Brief tab激活+表单可编辑+步骤条6步完整+当前步骤高亮买手下Brief

steps.text: ═══ Phase 3: 买手填写Brief并提交 → PENDING_BRIEF ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const textareas = document.querySelectorAll('textarea'); const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=text], input:not([type])'); const results = []; for (const ta of textareas) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(ta, '简约都市风格定位，目标25-35岁职业女性，追求质感与实穿性平衡'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); results.push('textarea_filled'); } return { filled: results.length, textareaCount: textareas.length, inputCount: inputs.length }; })()
steps.description: P3操作: 填写Brief表单(风格定位等必填项)

steps.expression: (() => { const submitBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('提交') && !b.disabled); if (submitBtn) { submitBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, msg: '提交按钮不可用' }; })()
steps.description: P3操作: 点击提交产运确认

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const activeStep = document.querySelector('.ant-steps-item-process')?.textContent.trim(); const isPending = text.includes('待确认') || text.includes('产运确认') || activeStep?.includes('产运确认'); const briefReadonly = !document.querySelector('textarea:not([readonly])'); return { isPending, activeStep, briefReadonly }; })()
steps.description: P3断言: 状态流转到PENDING_BRIEF(步骤条高亮产运确认+Brief只读)

steps.expression: (() => { const confirmBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('确认') && !b.textContent.includes('驳回') && !b.disabled); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, msg: '确认按钮不可用' }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const activeStep = document.querySelector('.ant-steps-item-process')?.textContent.trim(); const isInProduction = activeStep?.includes('试拍') || text.includes('试拍') || text.includes('上传'); const activeTab = document.querySelector('.ant-tabs-tab-active')?.textContent.trim(); const uploadArea = !!document.querySelector('[class*=upload], input[type=file]'); return { isInProduction, activeStep, activeTab, uploadArea }; })()
steps.description: P4断言: 状态流转到IN_PRODUCTION(步骤条高亮试拍+切换到试拍tab)

steps.text: ═══ Phase 5: 产运发起评审 → IN_REVIEW ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const reviewBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('发起评审') && !b.disabled); if (reviewBtn) { reviewBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, msg: '发起评审按钮不可用(可能试拍数据未达标)' }; })()
steps.description: P5操作: 产运发起评审

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const activeStep = document.querySelector('.ant-steps-item-process')?.textContent.trim(); const isInReview = activeStep?.includes('审核') || text.includes('审核视图'); const reviewView = !!document.querySelector('[class*=review], [class*=gallery]'); const groupNav = !!document.querySelector('[class*=group-nav], [class*=sidebar]'); return { isInReview, activeStep, reviewView, groupNav }; })()
steps.description: P5断言: 状态流转到IN_REVIEW(步骤条高亮试拍审核+审核视图展示)

steps.text: ═══ Phase 6: 买手审核通过 → PENDING_LEADER ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const passBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent.includes('通过') || b.textContent.includes('提交审核')) && !b.disabled); if (passBtn) { passBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, msg: '审核通过按钮不可用' }; })()
steps.description: P6操作: 买手完成审核(通过)

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const activeStep = document.querySelector('.ant-steps-item-process')?.textContent.trim(); const isPendingLeader = activeStep?.includes('Leader') || activeStep?.includes('复核') || text.includes('待Leader'); const resultView = text.includes('结果视图') || text.includes('通过图片'); return { isPendingLeader, activeStep, resultView }; })()
steps.description: P6断言: 状态流转到PENDING_LEADER(步骤条高亮Leader复核+结果视图)

steps.expression: (() => { const confirmPassBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('确认通过') && !b.disabled); if (confirmPassBtn) { confirmPassBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, msg: '确认通过按钮不可用' }; })()
steps.description: P7操作: Leader确认通过(归档)

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const activeStep = document.querySelector('.ant-steps-item-process, .ant-steps-item-finish')?.textContent.trim(); const isArchived = text.includes('归档') || text.includes('基准包'); const archiveTab = document.querySelector('.ant-tabs-tab-active')?.textContent.trim(); const hasPackageId = text.includes('基准包') || text.includes('package'); const readOnly = !Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).some(b => !b.disabled && (b.textContent.includes('编辑') || b.textContent.includes('提交'))); return { isArchived, activeStep, archiveTab, hasPackageId, readOnly }; })()
steps.description: P7断言: 状态流转到ARCHIVED(归档tab激活+基准包展示+全页只读)

steps.text: ═══ Phase 8: 时间线完整性验证 ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const timelineBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, [class*=timeline]')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('时间线')); if (timelineBtn) { timelineBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: P8操作: 打开时间线抽屉

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer, [class*=drawer]'); const text = drawer?.textContent || ''; const expectedEvents = ['创建', '提交', '确认', '评审', '审核', '通过', '归档']; const foundEvents = expectedEvents.filter(e => text.includes(e)); return { drawerOpen: !!drawer, foundEvents, eventCount: foundEvents.length, expectedCount: expectedEvents.length, allFound: foundEvents.length >= 5 }; })()
steps.description: P8断言: 时间线记录完整(创建/提交/确认/评审/审核/通过/归档事件)

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在无进行中迭代的店铺，各角色账号可用
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 店铺列表新增视觉迭代
2. 验证进入Brief草稿(DRAFT_BRIEF)
3. 买手填写并提交Brief→PENDING_BRIEF
4. 产运确认Brief→IN_PRODUCTION
5. 产运发起评审→IN_REVIEW
6. 买手审核通过→PENDING_LEADER
7. Leader确认通过→ARCHIVED
8. 时间线完整性验证
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 创建迭代后进入Brief草稿，步骤条6步完整
2. Brief提交后步骤条高亮产运确认，Brief变只读
3. 确认后切换到试拍tab，步骤条高亮试拍
4. 发起评审后进入审核视图，步骤条高亮试拍审核
5. 买手审核后步骤条高亮Leader复核，展示结果视图
6. Leader确认通过后进入归档tab，基准包展示，全页只读
7. 时间线记录所有状态变化事件
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/端到端
